notes.title: Gamescom Demo Gamepad Update
notes.content:
Players will now be able to play Exodus of Descent using a gamepad controller! View the controls at the main menu or choose the option within the pause menu during gameplay. The game and UI will auto-switch to using a gamepad once it is detected being used by the player.

Patch Notes:
- Added full controller support
- Changed dungeon key layout
- Fixed some menu bugs
- Fixed bug that enabled movement during ability usage
- Stability updates

tags.bug: - Fixed some menu bugs
- Fixed bug that enabled movement during ability usage

notes.title: Bow and Arrow Update
notes.content:
The Bow & Arrow weapon type is now available!

- Added the Bow & Arrow weapon type to the default "Outlaw" class on spawn
- Added "arrows" as lootable items
- Fixed character movement glitch that would freeze player movement during hit animation / secondary attacks
- Fixed enemy AI glitch that would follow player during attack animations

NOTE: These changes are applied to the Gamescom demo currently live for playtesting. If playtesting, please report found bugs in the official discord forums.

Thanks!
TheCrisp

notes.title: Playtest for Next Fest is now Open!
notes.content:
All people wishing to play are now able to try out the early pre-alpha build of the game!

Explore a demo dungeon with up to 6 players online. (At least 3 need to be matchmaking before the servers will spin up a match.)

Join our Discord to report bugs, make suggestions, and stay up-to-date! https://discord.gg/exodusofdescent


I will be working this week on quality-of-life fixes and major issues as they arise. I will increase/decrease server capacity as needed throughout the week.

Thanks for playtesting and Happy Next Fest!

- TheCrisp11

tags.balance_change: I will increase/decrease server capacity as needed throughout the week.
